static int
ddIsIthAddVarPair(
  DdManager * dd,
  DdNode * f,
  DdNode * g,
  unsigned int  i)
{
    return(f->index == i && g->index == i && 
           cuddT(f) == DD_ONE(dd) && cuddE(f) == DD_ZERO(dd) &&
           cuddT(g) == DD_ZERO(dd) && cuddE(g) == DD_ONE(dd));

}
